title: caroxylon angolense
intro: Caroxylon angolense, commonly known as the Quinua or Quinoa plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Amaranthaceae. This plant is known for its edible seeds, which provide a rich source of nutrients and have been used for centuries in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Caroxylon angolense include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and provide antioxidant and anti-diabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
